name: Measured progress
summary: Recording measured work as progress assets on a design: geometry, the stage's measurement formula, dated quantities and who can see them. The pipeline-derived progress feeds dashboards and reports.

roles.note: Support users see and create inactive measurements that customers do not see (PROG-REQ-016).

nfr.statement: Today, recalculation runs synchronously, once per structure, category and stage, after every asset change. There is no queue or rate limit, so bulk stage changes can start many aggregations at once.
nfr.open_question: What bulk-edit size must stay responsive, and is asynchronous recalculation acceptable?

nfr.statement: Maximum progress assets per project and per sheet that measurement, rollup and viewing must support.
nfr.open_question: What are today's largest projects (assets, structures, snapshots), and what is the growth target?

requirements.title: Progress projects derive progress that dashboards and reports use
requirements.statement: For progress projects, the processing pipeline also derives progress, and dashboards and reports are generated from that progress.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

open_checks: Report acknowledgment and notification are claimed before delivery succeeds; recovery after owner-side failure is unproven

acceptance_criteria.given: A progress project with a processed capture
acceptance_criteria.then: Progress is derived for the captured locations, and the dashboards and reports for that date use it

requirements.title: How a measured quantity is calculated
requirements.statement: A progress asset's quantity is its manually entered actual measurement if there is one, otherwise the stage's formula applied to its geometry and height, in either case multiplied by a factor. The factor defaults to the stage multiplier, then 1. The height defaults to the stage height, then the category height, then 1.

sources.title: Track3D "Single Source of Truth" docs, generated from code

open_checks: An explicit zero factor or height falls back to the default

acceptance_criteria.given: A wall polyline 10 m long, on a stage whose formula is length × height, with stage height 3 and stage multiplier 2
acceptance_criteria.when: The asset is saved with no metrics, height or actual measurement in the request

acceptance_criteria.given: The same asset with an actual measurement of 45 entered
acceptance_criteria.then: Its quantity is 45 × 2 = 90, and the geometry is not used

requirements.title: A progress asset needs a valid category, stage and design
requirements.statement: A progress asset can only be created with an existing category and a stage that belongs to it. Geometry drawn on a design requires that design to be valid.

acceptance_criteria.given: A category without a stage S
acceptance_criteria.when: A user creates an asset with that category and stage S
acceptance_criteria.then: Creation is rejected with an invalid-stage message

requirements.title: Inactive and "do not track" assets are excluded from progress
requirements.statement: Assets that are inactive or marked "do not track" count toward no progress totals, zone figures or trends. Marking an asset "do not track" removes out-of-scope work without deleting it.

sources.title: Track3D "Single Source of Truth" docs, generated from code

acceptance_criteria.given: Two active assets of 10 units each, one marked "do not track"

requirements.title: Support-entered progress starts hidden from customers
requirements.statement: Progress recorded by a support user on a date with no snapshot creates an inactive snapshot, which customers don't see. Progress recorded by a customer creates an active one, and a customer can activate an existing inactive snapshot. Missing project time zones default to America/New_York.

acceptance_criteria.given: No snapshot exists for 2026-03-02 on a structure
acceptance_criteria.when: A support user records progress for that date
acceptance_criteria.then: An inactive snapshot is created, and customers do not see that progress until it is activated

requirements.title: Stages are changed manually
requirements.statement: Users can manually move progress assets to a new stage on a given date. The system never promotes a stage automatically. Stored stage predecessors are not enforced today.

sources.title: Track3D "Single Source of Truth" docs, generated from code
sources.at: features/progress-calculation.md §2 (Stage transitions are manual; predecessors not enforced)

acceptance_criteria.when: A user with update rights moves it to Drywall on a chosen date
acceptance_criteria.then: The asset is in Drywall from that date, and both stages' progress is recalculated
